zh1:
怡君：這是我家。請進！
安同：很漂亮的房子！
（他們走進怡君的房子裡。）
怡君：請坐！要不要喝茶？
安同：好，謝謝你。你家有很多照片。
怡君：我家人都很喜歡照相。
安同：這張照片很好看。這是誰？你姐姐嗎？
怡君：不是，是我妹妹。這是我爸爸、媽媽。
安同：你家人都很好看。
py1:
Yíjūn：Zhè shì wǒ jiā. Qǐng jìn!
Āntóng：Hěn piàoliang de fángzi!
（Tāmen zǒu jìn Yíjūn de fángzi lǐ.）
Yíjūn：Qǐng zuò! Yào bú yào hē chá?
Āntóng：Hǎo, xièxie nǐ. Nǐ jiā yǒu hěn duō zhàopiàn.
Yíjūn：Wǒ jiārén dōu hěn xǐhuān zhàoxiàng.
Āntóng：Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn hěn hǎokàn. Zhè shì shéi? Nǐ jiějie ma?
Yíjūn：Bú shì, shì wǒ mèimei. Zhè shì wǒ bàba, māma.
Āntóng：Nǐ jiārén dōu hěn hǎokàn.
en1:
Yijun：This is my house. Please come in.
Antong：This is a pretty house.
[They enter Yijun's house.]
Yijun：Please have a seat. Would you like some tea?
Antong：Yes, thank you. You have a lot of pictures in your house.
Yijun：The people in my family like to take pictures.
Antong：This is a nice picture. Who is this? Your older sister?
Yijun：No, that is my younger sister. These are my dad and mom.
Antong：The people in your family are very good-looking.
zh2:
明華：田中，歡迎！歡迎！請進。
田中：謝謝。
明華：田中，這是我媽媽。
田中：伯母，您好。
明華的媽媽：你好，你好。來！來！請坐。你叫什麼名字？
田中：我叫誠一。你們家有很多書。
明華：都是我哥哥的書。他是老師，他很喜歡看書。
明華的媽媽：誠一，你家有幾個人？你有沒有兄弟姐妹？
田中：我家有五個人，我有兩個妹妹。
py2:
Mínghuá：Tiánzhōng, huānyíng! Huānyíng! Qǐng jìn.
Tiánzhōng：Xièxie.
Mínghuá：Tiánzhōng, zhè shì wǒ māma.
Tiánzhōng：Bómǔ, nín hǎo.
Mínghuá de māma：Nǐ hǎo, nǐ hǎo. Lái! Lái! Qǐng zuò. Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
Tiánzhōng：Wǒ jiào Chéngyī. Nǐmen jiā yǒu hěn duō shū.
Mínghuá：Dōu shì wǒ gēge de shū. Tā shì lǎoshī, tā hěn xǐhuān kànshū.
Mínghuá de māma：Chéngyī, nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ ge rén? Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu xiōngdì jiěmèi?
Tiánzhōng：Wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ ge rén, wǒ yǒu liǎng ge mèimei.
en2:
Minghua：Tianzhong, welcome, welcome. Please come in.
Tianzhong：Thank you!
Minghua：Tianzhong, this is my mom.
Tianzhong：Mrs. Li (Lit. “Auntie”), how are you?
Minghua's mother：Hello. Come in. Come. Please have a seat. What's your name?
Tianzhong：My name is Chengyi. You have a lot of books.
Minghua：They are all my brother's books. He is a teacher. He likes to read.
Minghua's mother：Chengyi, how many people are there in your family? Do you have any brothers or sisters?
Tianzhong：There are five people in my family. I have two younger sisters.
act:
I. Counting from 1 to 10
【目標 Goal】Practise counting from 1 to 10.
【做法 Task】Read the numbers aloud in order.
【例】一 yī、二 èr、三 sān、四 sì、五 wǔ、六 liù、七 qī、八 bā、九 jiǔ、十 shí

II. Other People's Families
【目標 Goal】Learning to ask about people in your friend's family.
【做法 Task】Ask classmates the questions and record what you find out.
【例】你有沒有兄弟姐妹？
你的兄弟姐妹是老師嗎？
你有你家人的照片嗎？有幾張？
你家人都喜歡喝咖啡嗎？
你家人都喜歡照相嗎？

III. Introducing Your Family
【目標 Goal】Learning to talk about family members' likes and dislikes.
【做法 Task】While one student introduces their family, the others record the name, country, family members, who likes taking photos, who likes coffee, and who has many books.
【例】名字／國籍／家人／誰喜歡照相／誰喜歡喝咖啡／誰有很多書

IV. People, Things, and Events
【目標 Goal】Use simple sentences to describe people, things, and events.
【做法 Task】Pair up and discuss the textbook pictures, then report the results to the class.
【例】哪一張照片漂亮？
他們是誰？
誰的書很多？
誰的爸爸喜歡照相？
誰不喜歡看書？
誰有好喝的茶？
cult:
以「家庭」為核心的華人文化 Family Central to Chinese Culture
在傳統華人文化中，家庭扮演著最核心的角色。許多父母期望與子女（特別是兒子）同住。在過去，兒子在婚後仍會與父母同住，並且繼承家族財產；而女兒出嫁後往往被視為「外人」，既不與父母同住，也無法繼承遺產。

現代社會已較少見到「三代同堂」，但許多年輕夫婦婚後仍住在父母附近，以便彼此照應。許多雙薪家庭會請祖父母幫忙照顧孩子，既可節省保母費，也能放心把孩子交給親人。現代臺灣人結婚年齡逐漸延後，而未婚成年人依傳統觀念仍被視為孩子，因此不少三、四十歲的未婚人士仍與父母同住，繼續接受父母照顧。

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: Possessive 的 de

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: 的 de is used to show possession and is placed between the possessor and the object possessed.
blocks.ex:
我的書
my book
你們的照片
your photo
李老師的姐姐
Teacher Li’s sister
哥哥的老師
brother’s teacher

blocks.label: 結構
blocks.text: 的 de can be omitted when the relationship is close, such as family members or home. When omitted, the possessor must be a pronoun.
blocks.ex:
我媽媽
my mom
我們老師
our teacher
李先生的爸爸
Mr. Li’s dad

blocks.label: 用法
blocks.text: When an individual and an affiliated group have a possessive relationship, the pronoun usually appears in the plural form.
blocks.ex:
他們家
their home
我們日本
our Japan

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: 的 de is used between the modifier and the head noun.
blocks.ex:
漂亮的小姐
pretty young lady
好喝的咖啡
tasty coffee
很好看的房子
beautiful house

blocks.label: 用法
blocks.text: 的 de can be omitted when the modifier and head noun are frequently used together.
blocks.ex:
哪國人？
person from which country?
臺灣人
Taiwanese people

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: Possessive 有 yǒu

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: The verb 有 yǒu refers to possession or ownership.
blocks.ex:
我有很多照片。
I have many photos.
他們有好喝的茶。
They have good-tasting tea.

blocks.label: 否定
blocks.text: 有 yǒu is always negated with 沒 méi, forming 沒有 méiyǒu.
blocks.ex:
他沒有房子。
He does not have a house.
我沒有書。
I do not have a book.
我沒有兄弟姐妹。
I do not have any brothers or sisters.

blocks.label: 疑問
blocks.text: The A-not-A form for 有 yǒu is 有沒有 yǒu méiyǒu.
blocks.ex:
你們有沒有好喝的咖啡？
Do you have good-tasting coffee?
你有幾張照片？
How many photos do you have?
你們有烏龍茶嗎？
Do you have Oolong tea?

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: Totality 都 dōu

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: 都 dōu indicates that all items referred to by the subject or object noun have something in common.
blocks.ex:
我們都姓陳。
We are all surnamed Chen.
這兩個房子都是他的。
Both houses are his.
他的兄弟姐妹都很好看。
His siblings are all good-looking.

blocks.label: 結構
blocks.text: 都 dōu is placed after the noun it relates to and before the main verb phrase: Noun + 都 + VP.
blocks.ex:
我們都是美國人。
We are all American.
李先生、陳小姐都喜歡喝茶。
Mr. Li and Miss Chen both like tea.

blocks.label: 否定
blocks.text: Noun + 都 + 不／沒 + VP expresses total negation. 不都 expresses partial negation.
blocks.ex:
我們都不是美國人。
None of us is American.
我們都沒有哥哥。
None of us has an older brother.
他們不都是臺灣人。
Not all of them are Taiwanese.

blocks.label: 疑問
blocks.text: 都 dōu can be used with 嗎 questions but not with A-not-A questions.
blocks.ex:
你們都是美國人嗎？
Are you all American?
你的家人都要喝咖啡嗎？
Do all your family members want coffee?

blocks.label: 用法
blocks.text: 都 is an adverb and cannot appear before the subject. All members covered by 都 must appear before 都. It works with 嗎 questions, but not A-not-A questions.

gps.title: V. Measures 個 ge and 張 zhāng

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: Measure Words 個 ge and 張 zhāng

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: A measure word is placed between a number and a noun.
blocks.ex:
一個哥哥
one brother
幾個老師？
How many teachers?
兩張好看的照片
two pretty photos
哪三個人？
Which three people?

blocks.label: 結構
blocks.text: Number + Measure + Noun; or Determiner + Number + Measure + Noun. When 哪 is followed by 一, 一 is often omitted.
blocks.ex:
三個人
three people
哪一張照片？
Which photo?
哪個人？
Which person?

blocks.label: 用法
blocks.text: 個 ge is the most common general measure word. 張 zhāng is used for flat objects such as paper, photos, and tables. Before a measure word, use 兩 liǎng rather than 二 èr.
blocks.ex:
兩個妹妹
two younger sisters
兩個日本人
two Japanese people
兩張照片
two photos
